_note: Single-source (early-medieval Slavic, pre-Christian/pagan). Slavic sub-palette; forest-and-swamp clans of taiga, wood, bog and plain, ruled by knyaz and veche, served by the volkhv at the kapishche. clan = clanhold. Even split Neutral/Chaotic. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Slavic register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon through Slavic phonology (family_slavic.json theonym_set), never real Slavic gods (the culture-name Velesan/Velesia is a traditional proper name only, not a worshipped deity).

phonology.palette: Slavic: palatalization (soft/hard); sibilants sh/zh/ch/shch; clusters; vowels a e i o u y; dithematic glory-names; theophoric stems are the Slavic morphs (Tulor-, Orlon-, Numir-, Relata-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC and heavy clusters (str, zdr, vl, mn, sht); mobile stress.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic -ov / -ev / -ich (son of); the rod (kin-clan) name + -ichi; the Dedy (ancestral spirits) honored.
morphology.compounding_rule: dithematic clan-names (-slav glory, -mir peace/world, -volod rule): Velislav, Borimir; toponyms quality + feature: Chorn-boloto (black-swamp), Bel-gorod (white-town).

title_ladder.government: clanhold (knyaz and the veche folk-assembly; the voevoda leads the druzhina, the volkhv reads the gods' will)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Slavic clanhold, ascending. Built on knyaz (prince) and the rod-clans: Knyaz (prince) principality, Velik Knyaz (grand prince) kingdom, Kagan (over-king of many princes) empire over the Kaganat. Boyar (noble) barony; Krainik (border-warden) march; Zhupan (district chief) county; Voevoda (war-leader) duchy. The veche checks the knyaz; a clan culture rarely rises past the knyaz. (Rank titles are the real Slavic register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: personal (often dithematic -slav/-mir) + patronymic -ov/-ich; the rod (clan) name; a deed/nature byname for the renowned.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the knyaz- and boyar-rods carry dithematic glory-names; commoners a single name + patronymic.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoking the morphed powers + a Slavic element: -slav (glory-of), Bog- / Bogu- (god-), -dar (gift-of): e.g. Tuloslav, Bogudar, Numirslav.

religion._note: Deity-names are phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon through Slavic phonology (family_slavic.json theonym_set) - never real Slavic gods (no Perun/Veles/Svarog/Mokosh/Lada/Morana). Neutral and Chaotic: Neutral clans honor the Dedy (ancestral dead), the rod-spirits and the land-powers; Chaotic war-bands swear by the storm and the wild-hunt powers. The volkhv mediates at the kapishche.
religion.the_one: Oterun (< Aeternus; the distant Heaven-Father, seldom petitioned)
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the wild and grasping powers keep their Slavic morphs + a portfolio epithet (distinct per power): Maraxus -> Marakh the War-Fire; Vacidus -> Vakid the Unmaker; Lusanto -> Lusan the Hoard-Serpent.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Kapishche (idol-shrine) of [power]: 'the Kapishche of Tulor', set with carved idoly in the sacred grove.
religion.saints_pattern: the Dedy (ancestral dead) and the rod-spirits honored at the kurgan (grave-mound) and the hearth; the Lawful-leaning add 'the Blessed [name]'.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tulor: a six-spoked sun-wheel over a hearth-flame
holy_symbol_motifs.Numir: an axe and thunder-mark above an oak

banks_patterns.ships: river-trade ladya boats: 'the Grey Wolf', 'Swan of the Reka', 'the Far-rower'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [knyaz] Druzhina (war-band) / the [animal] spears: 'the Wolf-Druzhina', 'the Bear-spears'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: abandoned kapishcha and barrow-kurgans: 'the Kapishche of [name]', 'the Kurgan of [knyaz]'
